spec.situation_desc: couldn't pay a bill on time because the mobile app was down

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Hello, you’re through to Priya at Thistle Bank. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Tariq Ferreira. I couldn’t pay my electricity bill on time because your mobile app was down. I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry the app being unavailable got in the way of making your payment, Tariq. I can look into this, but first I need to verify your identity. Could you tell me your full name and date of birth?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I’m sorry you’ve had this experience. I’ll log this as a complaint about the app outage affecting your bill payment.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Good, because I don’t think I should be left dealing with a late charge when the app wasn’t working.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand why you’re frustrated. I’ll include the late payment and any charge you’ve been notified about in the complaint, so it can be reviewed. I can’t promise what the outcome will be.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll submit the complaint today and make sure it’s recorded with those details. I’ll also arrange for our complaints team to contact you by 27 October with an update on the review.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And when will I get a proper answer?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’ll receive a full written response within 8 weeks of today. That response will explain what we’ve found and what we’ve decided.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise: I’m logging your complaint about the app outage and its effect on your bill payment, I’ll submit it today, and the complaints team will contact you by 27 October. You’ll get a full written response within 8 weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Tariq. I’m sorry again for the trouble this caused, and I’ll make sure the complaint is passed on today.
